projection_policy: Observed numerical phase summaries remain unrounded. Identity values become within-run stability checks and ordinal segment numbers. Absent receiver metrics are omitted. No rates are interpolated across phase/settle boundaries.

restoration.ordering_basis: Restored flags and clicked flags in the final result, unchanged reviewed runner order, and ordered completion of its final four Runtime.evaluate commands. Expressions are intentionally absent from the sanitized trace.
